_about: Which of our files may use a power, and why. tools/check_capabilities.py fails on any use that is not listed here, on anything that is never allowed (eval, exec, pickle, marshal, ctypes, the registry, shell=True), and on any entry the code no longer needs. Add an entry only after a person has read the code that uses the power. Paths are as they are in the repository under Source/.

process.client/k2_patch.py: Runs the Windows 'tasklist' command (fixed arguments, 10 second limit) to see whether the game is running before the client rewrites game files.
process.worlds/kotor2/ClientLauncher.py: Only when a player clicks the 'KOTOR 2 Client' button in the Archipelago Launcher: probes whether Kivy imports in the chosen Python, and starts the installed client in a new console window. Nothing runs while a seed is generated.
process.tools/k2compile.py: The one place a game script is compiled: runs tools/nwnsc/nwnsc.exe (or the old nwnnsscomp.exe when present) on an .nss file with a fixed argument list and a time limit.
process.tools/build_payload.py: Developer tool: runs our own builder scripts as separate Python processes (sys.executable, fixed argument lists) to collect the files the client carries.
process.tools/prepare_game_scripts.py: Developer tool: runs our own generator scripts (class tables, gate wrappers, Bazaar, Vendor, extra companion assets) as separate Python processes with the game folder as an argument.
process.tools/build_class_script.py: Developer tool: runs our class-rebuild generator and the script compiler on the result.
process.tools/check_yamls.py: Developer tool: runs Archipelago's Generate.py on test YAML files in a scratch folder.
process.tools/package_world.py: Developer tool: runs Python to build the .apworld archive from the world folder.
process.tools/run_client_tests.py: Developer tool: runs the client test files, one Python process each.
process.tools/run_world_tests.py: Developer tool: runs the world's unit tests in a Python process inside the Archipelago folder.
process.tools/stage_publish.py: Developer tool: runs the provenance check on the staged repository folder.

delete.client/k2_patch.py: Revert: removes an Override file the client wrote (only one it recorded as its own), or puts the saved original back.
delete.client/k2_files.py: Removes the client's own dispatcher inbox file once the game has read it.
delete.client/k2_journal.py: Revert: after dialog.tlk is put back from the client's backup, removes that backup and its record.
delete.client/k2_modules.py: Revert: after a module file is put back from the client's backup, removes the backup; a backup whose module was changed by something else since is dropped too, so it can never overwrite the newer file.
delete.client/test_context.py: Tests only: remove the scratch folders the test created.
delete.client/test_dialogues.py: Tests only: remove a scratch copy of a module archive the test created.
delete.client/test_dispatcher.py: Tests only: remove the scratch folders the test created.
delete.client/test_modules.py: Tests only: remove a scratch module file the test created.
delete.client/test_patch.py: Tests only: remove the scratch folders the test created.
delete.client/test_payload.py: Tests only: remove the scratch folders the test created.
delete.tools/build_area_hooks.py: Developer tool, --remove: removes the area files this tool wrote.
delete.tools/build_area_wrappers.py: Developer tool, --remove: removes the wrapper files this tool wrote and its manifest.
delete.tools/build_class_script.py: Developer tool: removes the old compiled class script before it is compiled again.
delete.tools/build_gate_wrappers.py: Developer tool: removes the old compiled wrapper before it is compiled again.
delete.tools/build_payload.py: Developer tool: clears its own work folder and removes files of an earlier build that are no longer made.
delete.tools/check_yamls.py: Developer tool: removes its own scratch folders.
delete.tools/k2_dispatch_send.py: Developer tool: 'clear' removes the dispatcher inbox and outbox files.
delete.tools/k2compile.py: Removes its own compiler output files before and after a compile.
delete.tools/ci_layout.py: GitHub checks only: clears the temporary folders it lays the repository files out in on the build machine.
delete.tools/package_world.py: Developer tool: clears the build folder before it packs the world.
delete.tools/run_world_tests.py: Developer tool: replaces the copy of the world inside the Archipelago folder before running the tests.
